summary: The candidate correctly excludes no-test-evidence targets from matrix grants and preserves the planner-side uncharged park through the split shape predicate. No defects found.

evidence: The base already parks no-test-evidence records before any reservation or cell: `src/host/matrix-planner.ts` runs `parkNoTestEvidenceRecords` before selection and its base planner excludes those configs from grants.

Base tests `tests/host/matrix-planner-no-test-evidence_test.ts` cover a no-evidence target and a stale implementation intent, asserting zero cells, zero reservations, no model calls, and a blocked record carrying `no_ci_and_no_local_verify`.

The base also handles a cell-side park: `src/host/matrix-cell.ts` returns `not_started` for a record already parked with `no_ci_and_no_local_verify`, verified by `tests/host/matrix-cell-no-test-park_test.ts`.
